title: Question Ball
shareTitle: Question Ball — Toss, Talk, and Share
description: Pick a familiar topic, toss a soft rainbow Question Ball, hear one open-ended question, and share your idea aloud.
learningGoals: Build expressive language through open-ended Who, What, Why, and How questions
Practice describing, explaining, imagining, and naming feelings
Practice conversational turn-taking with a nearby co-player
interactionModel: Choose one of four picture topics, tap or physically swipe a bounded felt ball, then hold to record locally or share aloud with someone nearby.
feedbackModel: Every shared idea earns a warm puppet celebration and one Sharing Star; answers are never transcribed, judged, or scored.

modes.title: Amazing Animals
modes.skill: use animal vocabulary to describe, explain, and imagine

modes.title: Let’s Imagine
modes.skill: practice flexible thinking and invented explanations

persistence: Only Sharing Star count, completed count per topic, and last selected topic are stored in localStorage under qlobe-question-ball-v1. Child recordings remain memory-only for the current question.

assets.runtimeNetworkScope: No game asset, model, transcription, or child-recording requests; inherited platform analytics is outside this flag.
assets.art: GPT Image 2 and local-model cozy felt puppet assets
assets.voice: Qwen voice-cloned teacher narration with Web Speech fallback

credits: Cozy felt production art made with GPT Image 2, local Krea 2, and Qwen Image Layered; teacher narration made with local Qwen voice clone and verified with Whisper. Child recordings never leave the device. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
